GOBARdhan Central Sector Scheme

 _The GOBARdhan Central Sector Scheme has come into effect with a total outlay of ₹23,731 crore and will continue till 2035–36._ 

🔹 Main Focus: Scaling up the production and use of Compressed Biogas (CBG) in India.
🔹 Target: Increase domestic CBG production nearly ten-fold.
🔹 Investment: Encourage large-scale private investment in the biogas sector.
🔹 Objective: Build a strong circular bioeconomy by converting organic waste into useful energy and other resources.
🔹 Energy Goal: Establish CBG as an important pillar of India’s future energy mix.
🔹 Approval: The Union Cabinet approved the scheme on 6 August 2026.
🔹 Implementation Period: 2026–27 to 2035–36.

 Exam Point : GOBARdhan = _Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan_ , focusing on converting waste into wealth and promoting clean energy.
